## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` pass (CI runs these too)

- [ ] Checked at desktop **and** phone width; keyboard usable; no console errors
- [ ] No secrets, `.env.local`, recordings or participant data committed
- [ ] Demo/sample content is clearly labeled; no fabricated metrics
- [ ] Screenshot attached (UI changes)
